time_correction.instructions: Compare both implementations for safe money handling, retained decisions and maintainable authored behavior using only the supplied capabilities; your selection does not verify code.

criteria.A: Retire the old charge through cancel, observe its cumulative settlement, request the outstanding refund explicitly, then obtain fresh release evidence before exporting the replacement with a new source. Either sign of correction follows one workflow, at the expense of refunding and collecting again and possible manual finance work.
criteria.B: Preserve the first invoice and settle the difference: an increase creates another source charge, a decrease asks for a partial refund, and delta settlement is checked before completion. Fewer money round trips are possible, while revision accumulation, allocation correctness and active-interval/source tracking become additional business state.
